description: This source file defines a Spring component implementing the CommandStrategy interface, specifically for retrieving a loan transaction by external ID within a batch processing context. It parses request URLs, extracts necessary identifiers, and delegates the retrieval to the LoanTransactionsApiResource, handling responses and errors accordingly.

classes.name: GetLoanTransactionByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing the CommandStrategy interface to process batch requests for retrieving loan transactions by external ID.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve a loan transaction by external ID based on the request URL, parsing path and query parameters, and calling the LoanTransactionsApiResource to get the transaction data. It constructs and returns a BatchResponse with the transaction details or error status.
